correctness.rationale: The weighted Cayley extension formula gives P(d(u,v)=k)=(k+1)(n-2)_{k-1}/n^k. Conditioning the squared degrees on a fixed marked path via the weighted contracted-tree Pruefer code yields E[Z|distance k]=5n-11+6/n+(k-1)(2n-k(k+1))/(n(k+1)). The n-vertex Hamiltonian-path boundary is treated directly. Using t_k=(n-2)_{k-1}/n^k, sum identities S1=1-h, S2=(n+1)h-1 and S4=(3n^2+11n+1)h-(8n+1) yield Cov(Z,d)=4-(n+6)h. The first four terms give (n+6)sum_{k=1}^4 t_k-4=8(n-3)^2(n-2)/n^4>0 when n>=4; at n=2,3 Z is constant. Janson Wiener first moment supplies the stated asymptotic, independently of the finite proof. Independently reconstructed enumerations of all n^(n-2) Cayley trees n=2,...,7 give exact covariances 0,0,-3/8,-192/125,-35/9,-131520/16807 matching formula; these are corroborative only.
